Definition: Substituting co-referring terms inside a belief or knowledge context, where recognition matters. Not recognizing someone under one description does not change who they are.
Example: Someone argues, 'You know your father, but you do not know the masked man — so the masked man is not your father.'
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone argues, 'The disciples did not recognize the risen Jesus at first, so the man with them was not Jesus' — yet recognition is not identity.
HowToRespond: Separate knowing from being: 'Not recognizing someone under one description doesn't change who they are.'
